d: The Supreme Court has delivered a landmark clarification regarding the OBC Non-Creamy Layer (OBC-NCL) criteria. The apex court ruled that candidates cannot be excluded from OBC reservation solely based on their parents' salary; official post equivalence and service rules must be considered. In its November 6 order, the bench clarified that completed appointments will not be reopened, but UPSC Civil Services Examination 2025 candidates awaiting service allocation will be covered under this ruling.
